desc: When one of America's the most iconic firearms manufacturers teams up with The Leader in Rimfire Ammunition, great things happen. CCI has collaborated with Henry Repeating Arms, maker of the legendary Golden Boy lever-action rifle on a collector's edition load. Offered in 275-round bulk packs, the loads feature a 36-grain copper-plated hollow-point bullet pushed at 1,260 fps- perfect for targets and small game.
